title: Batman Arkham Knight #3 DC Comics 2015 Panosian Cover Arkham Trilogy Prequel
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Batman: Arkham Knight #3 (June 2015), DC Comics - the official prequel to the Arkham Knight video game, finale of the Arkham trilogy. Cover by Dan Panosian. Written by Peter J. Tomasi.

Back cover: Wrigley's 5 Ascent gum ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
